themes.title: Beijing weaponizing processing dominance
themes.description: China's Rare Earth Price Index hit 273.5 on Jul 16 (terbium oxide near $970/kg domestic, +30% on the quarter); the Oct-2025 US-China truce and tariff suspension run through Nov 10, 2026 — a key overhang for ex-China supply.

themes.title: China adds MP, USAR to entity list
themes.description: Beijing added 10 US entities — including MP Materials and USA Rare Earth — to its export-control list Jun 22, 2026, alongside a new violation-reporting mechanism effective Jul 1.

themes.title: Washington's playbook
themes.description: ~$2.9B in direct federal funding across rare-earth/magnet projects in a five-week Jun 2026 blitz (DoD, DoE, EXIM), plus a separate $1.6B DoC LOI and ~10% equity stake in USA Rare Earth — flowing to finished inputs, not just ore.

tiers.label: Established Producers
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Only US rare-earth mine + processing (Mountain Pass); $500M Apple magnet offtake ($200M upfront, shipments from 2027) + $400M DoD convertible preferred (DoD now largest shareholder, ~15%)
rows.watch for: Stock flat-to-down in 2026 despite deals; -13.4% in June alone after China added MP to its export-control entity list Jun 22

rows.angle: Largest non-China rare-earth producer (Australia/Malaysia); pushing into magnet metals
rows.watch for: Jul 22 Q4 FY26 results: record revenue A$288.9M (+70% YoY), record ASP A$98.2/kg, cash A$1.21B — but shares fell despite the beat; new CEO Pol Le Roux (from Jul 1) inks A$50M JS Link tie-up for a Malaysia magnet plant
China lithium carbonate futures hit a 5-month low (~136,800 yuan/t, ~$20.2k) on 2027 oversupply/restart fears; ALB pulled back to ~$115 from ~$121 a week earlier

rows.angle: Copper — the electrification metal at scale
rows.watch for: Q2 beat: realized copper $6.17/lb (+41.5% YoY), adj. EPS $0.74, revenue $7.03B — but Grasberg (Indonesia) output fell 18% (copper) / 39% (gold)

tiers.label: Developers / Small-Cap — Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: US rare-earth mine-to-magnet aspirant; Texas mine + Oklahoma magnet plant; DoC $1.6B LOI + ~10% equity stake (Jan 2026, priced $17.17)
rows.watch for: $2.83B Serra Verde (Brazil, Pela Ema — only non-Asia mine producing all 4 magnetic REEs) merger amended Jul 16, tied to offtake terms; shareholder vote Aug 28; leadership transition announced Jul 20; on China's export-control entity list

rows.angle: Uranium + rare-earth processing at White Mesa
rows.watch for: $725M DoD loan for separation/metallization plant (2028 target); pilot-scale terbium oxide (first US producer in decades, Mar 2026); mine-to-magnet buildout via ~$1.9B Vacuumschmelze deal + proposed Australian Strategic Materials acquisition
DoE $2.23B loan — $435M drawn, DoE holds 5% equity stake; shares pulled back sharply (~-28%) with the broader Lithium Triangle on oversupply fears

bear_case.title: Commodity cycles cut both ways
bear_case.description: Lithium's 2023–25 crash shows how fast oversupply can crush miners; China lithium carbonate just hit a fresh 5-month low on 2027 restart/glut fears.

bear_case.title: China can flood the market
bear_case.description: Beijing has historically dumped supply to crush Western rare-earth economics; price floors help but don't cover everyone.

bear_case.title: Juniors dilute
bear_case.description: Developers without cash flow fund construction via repeated equity raises; USAR/LAC-type names carry meaningful dilution risk.

bear_case.title: Policy dependency
bear_case.description: The thesis leans on sustained government support; a policy shift or trade détente removes a key prop.

catalysts.title: Lynas Q4 FY26: record revenue, shares fall anyway
catalysts.description: A$288.9M revenue (+70% YoY) and record A$98.2/kg ASP beat, but the stock declined on the print; new CEO Pol Le Roux signs A$50M JS Link deal for a Malaysia magnet plant.

catalysts.title: USA Rare Earth amends $2.83B Serra Verde merger
catalysts.description: Deal to acquire Brazil's Pela Ema mine (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb at scale) now conditioned on the offtake agreement holding; shareholder vote set for Aug 28, 2026.

catalysts.title: Freeport-McMoRan Q2 beat on copper strength
catalysts.description: Adj. EPS $0.74 / revenue $7.03B on copper realized at $6.17/lb (+41.5% YoY); tempered by an 18% drop in Grasberg (Indonesia) copper output.

catalysts.title: China's rare-earth price index hits 273.5
catalysts.description: Terbium oxide near $970/kg domestic (+30% on the quarter) as heavy rare earths (terbium, holmium, erbium, gadolinium) climb.

catalysts.title: China adds MP, USAR to export-control list
catalysts.description: 10 US entities added, alongside a new violation-reporting mechanism effective Jul 1 — watch for further retaliatory moves.

catalysts.title: US-China truce & tariff suspension expire
catalysts.description: Current general export licenses for rare earths/gallium/germanium/antimony/graphite run through this date — the sector's biggest swing factor if not extended.
